description:
Found by the T-019 and T-020 agents on 2026-10-05.

1. Article drop. `SUBJECT_OPENER_RE` needs a leading article. "Reader votes a sentence, so the vote stays stable." passes. 54 of 72 narration rows in hooks/lib/corpus_what_comments.jsonl escape this way.
2. Tag lines. `TAG_LINE_RE` makes `_narrates_code` skip any `label: text` comment. `# note: this loops over every page and returns the count` and `# noqa: E501 loops over every page` pass.
3. `//\s*@ts-[\w-]+` in `DIRECTIVE_COMMENT_RE` is unanchored, so `// @ts-expect-error <prose>` likely escapes.

Measure each fix on the extended corpus (187 rows after T-020). Narration recall must not drop.
title: Close the article-drop and tag-line comment escapes
